name: Puzzle Bobble DS
summary: Puzzle Bobble DS is a puzzle video game developed by Taito Corporation and released in 2005 for the Nintendo DS handheld console. This title is part of the famous Puzzle Bobble series, known for its addictive gameplay and colorful design. Puzzle Bobble DS retains the essence of its predecessors, focusing on the arcade-puzzle genre where players must launch colored bubbles to form groups of at least three bubbles of the same color, causing them to burst and disappear from the game board.
